name: Chidi Okonkwo
bio: Reigning national #1. Chidi races GT3 and prototype classes and led the SRN clean-sweep at the West Africa Sim Racing Cup.

activity.text: Won the West Africa Sim Racing Cup at Monza.
Set a new SRN track record at Spa in the GT3 class.
Hosted a setup workshop for new members.

name: Adaeze Nwosu
bio: GT4 specialist and one of the driving forces behind SRN Lagos meetups. Known for consistency over a full race distance.

activity.text: Organized the SRN Lagos meetup — 60 drivers, one track.
Podium finish at the ACC Endurance Series round 3.

name: Emeka Eze
bio: Vintage and touring car enthusiast who builds his own liveries for the community car pack.

activity.text: Released a new livery pack for the community touring car mod.

name: Tunde Adeyemi
bio: Newest driver to crack the national top 15. Builds and streams rig upgrades on weekends.

activity.text: Streamed a full Moza R21 rig build.

name: Ifeoma Chukwu
bio: Runs the SRN newcomer program, pairing first-time racers with mentors for their first ten races.

activity.text: Onboarded 14 new racers into the mentor program.

name: Bola Afolabi
bio: One of the few rFactor 2 regulars in the community — usually found tuning car setups late into the night.

activity.text: Shared a setup guide for the Formula Pro class.

name: Grace Udoh
bio: Endurance racing regular. Co-drove the SRN entry in the last two 6-hour community endurance events.

activity.text: Finished 2nd in the SRN 6-Hour Endurance Classic.

name: Segun Bakare
bio: Content creator covering SRN race weekends — highlight reels and onboard footage on the community media hub.

activity.text: Published the Lagos meetup highlight reel.
